'''Therj'io'nuruodo''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Interplanetary Component Exchange]] stationed on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Therj'io'nuruodo appears in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the I.C.E. reputation vendor.
